autoOffSeconds.title: Auto-off after N seconds
autoOffSeconds.description: When set, the switch auto-flips back to OFF this many seconds after being turned ON. The timer is cancelled on any subsequent setOn (manual OFF cancels cleanly; re-ON restarts the countdown). Leave unset (or 0) for a normal stateful switch that survives restarts.

cooldown.title: Cooldown time in seconds (legacy alias for autoOffSeconds)
cooldown.description: Deprecated — use autoOffSeconds. Honored as a fallback for existing configs.
